name: Shaanxi KJ-500
detection_curve: function detect(dist, rcs) { if (!Number.isFinite(dist) || dist < 0 || !Number.isFinite(rcs) || rcs < 0) return NaN; if (rcs === 0) return 0; const scaled_dist = dist / Math.pow(rcs, 0.25); return 1 / (1 + Math.exp(Math.log(9) * (scaled_dist - 470) / (470 - 225))); }
